pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer
So let them worship the Lord of this House
Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish
Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer
Let them adore the Lord of this House
Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger)
